title: Auxiliary Power Unit — Aft Heat Shield — Cut the Inspection Window Without the Bearing Conversion
abstract: Offers the aft heat shield inspection window on its own, for operators who want the inspection access before they are ready to take the spherical bearing conversion.

sections.planning_reason: The heat shield window was developed as part of the spherical bearing conversion, but the access benefit is independent of the bearing and several operators asked for it first. Dropping the aft heat shield adds six hours to a two hour inspection, and an operator doing eight inspections a year across a fleet spends most of a working week on shield removal alone. The bearing conversion is a twenty week lead item; the window is not, and there is no reason to make one wait for the other.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin gives the instructions to cut the inspection window in the aft heat shield and to fit the removable closing panel, without any change to the mount itself. The cut is made with the same template used by the bearing conversion bulletin and the resulting shield is identical, so an aircraft that takes this bulletin first does not repeat the operation when the bearing is later converted.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the tail cone access doors and drop the aft heat shield. Position the cutting template on the shield at the datum given in the installation drawing and clamp it. Cut the window, deburr the edge and treat it with the high temperature edge sealant. Fit the removable closing panel and confirm that it seats without a gap at any point. Reinstall the heat shield and torque the attachments to the values in AMM-T-49-10-12-200-001-A. Do the mount inspection through the new window and confirm that the aft attachment is fully visible; if it is not, the template was mispositioned and the shield must be replaced. Record the accomplishment and note it in the configuration record, because the bearing conversion bulletin will check for it and will skip its own window step.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to all TITAN-88 aircraft carrying the steel link that have not yet embodied the spherical bearing conversion. An aircraft that has already taken that bulletin has the window and this bulletin does not apply. Aircraft delivered from MSN T00205 have the window from the production line.
sections.material_note: Kit K4910-1020-01 contains the closing panel and its fasteners. The cutting template is a tooling item, available from the regional pool and shared with the bearing conversion. No long-lead item and nothing is returned.

type_data.compliance_time: At the operator's convenience, at any tail cone access.
